- [FACT] Regular dental cleanings help remove plaque buildup that can lead to cavities.

- [FACT] Skipping dental appointments can lead to missed diagnoses or delayed treatment for oral cancer.
- [FACT] Dental issues can worsen over time without regular checkups, leading to more invasive and expensive treatments such as root canals, crowns, or tooth extractions.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular dental checkups are important for maintaining good oral health and preventing serious dental problems.
